In the Teleport repository under /app, implement and exercise a focused Cloud SQL provider regression fixture grounded in lib/service/cfg.go, lib/srv/db/common/auth.go, and lib/srv/db/common/cloud.go. Use a scoped SQL Admin API identity to retrieve the initial root for project security-prod and instance orders, establish an authenticated orders-admin database connection, then rotate the provider fixture to its next root and database password. Refresh the same instance trust cache, establish a connection with the current root and password, and verify a query through it. Exercise one read-only provider-status request and one rejected database login as comparison cases. Write /app/cloudsql-rotation-report.json with the project and instance, provider generations, CA fingerprints, trust-cache file, database credential identifiers, connection identifiers, API identity scopes, file metadata, and relevant Teleport source locations. Do not print passwords, API tokens, or private keys.
